# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the canonical DroidOps instructions before
editing or reviewing code. Keep project policy in that file.

Use the [project skill index](../docs/development/AI_AGENTS.md) to identify relevant
`.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md` files. Automatic skill discovery varies across Copilot
surfaces; include the relevant file as context or read it explicitly when needed.
Do not assume that attaching this file also loads the linked instructions.
